edits.new:
Then the response holds no name, no e-mail address and no personal field of any role row, permission row or conflict pair

  Scenario: AC10 A call to an operation this story does not provide is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a service identity holds the Reference data R letter
    When the identity calls a path under /api/recovery/access/v1 that this story does not provide
    Then the call is answered with status 404

  Scenario: AC11 The rules of section 8 on the version and the read path hold together (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given matrix version PM-2026.11 is in force and a test user signs in
    When a version with a failed row is applied, the catalogue and the session are read, and each read is timed
    Then the failed version writes no row, the catalogue answers every role in force with its class, default scope, permission rows and conflict pairs, the session answers the roles, scope and conflict state only, no read calls another service, each read answers inside 2 s on the caller's thread, and no response holds a name, an e-mail address or a personal field
